svg.title: Flow: my match, the lobby code and reporting the result (player)
svg.text: 05 · Flow: my match, the lobby code and reporting the result (player)
Use case: Team Delta plays group E; a teammate sets the lobby code, the others join it, and two teams report the same order

g.text: lobby code · set by Player Two

svg.text: 1 · Your match is now
The lobby code fills the card: it is what
players need at the PC. A push says it is
set (U8, U9).

g.text: Made the lobby? Share its code
Four letters or digits. The other teams in this

svg.text: 2 · Set the code
Any player in the match sets it; a series'
later games keep it, as in the legacy.
after the game

g.text: Drag the teams into the order they finished
Top two go on to the semi-final

svg.text: 3 · Report by dragging
Nothing is pre-filled: the team drags the
order it saw. One report per team; it can
change until the match is decided.

g.text: Two teams sent the same order
We'll tell you when it's on

svg.text: 4 · Decided
Two matching reports from different
teams decide, as in the legacy; the next
round is built at once.

g.text: Team Gamma put you second; you put
The crew sees both reports and decides.
You'll get a message when it's settled.

svg.text: 5 · Disputed
Differing reports go to the crew's queue;
the teams see that and nothing else (U7,
Notes

Lobby codes stay on the phones of the players in the match: on the venue screen they would let anyone into a private lobby (U8). Reporting keeps the legacy's rule; a season made by the team builder can be set to 'crew enters every result' (U7).
